cues: Every morning becomes every evening, and the prayer for all creatures becomes a blessing on one small town.
The poem has the shape of a day, and of the whole play.
Then the frankest line: whether they last the night is always touch and go.
It is an astonishingly plain thing for a clergyman to say.
He promises no protection; faith does not remove the risk.
text: Stanza two mirrors the first. Every morning becomes every evening, and the prayer for all creatures becomes a blessing on one small town. The poem has the shape of a day, and of the whole play. Then the frankest line: whether they last the night is always touch and go. It means highly uncertain. It is an astonishingly plain thing for a clergyman to say. He promises no protection; faith does not remove the risk.
